claims.claim: Diego Moreira is a Belgian winger who joined AC Milan in August 2026
claims.note: Statement dated 19 Aug 2026 announces the signing; Belgian nationality stated.

claims.claim: Announced 19 August from RC Strasbourg; contract until 30 June 2031; number 22
claims.note: Page reads 'contract with the club until 30 June 2031' and 'will wear the number 22 shirt'.

claims.claim: beIN reported a fee of EUR 50m plus EUR 16m add-ons on a five-year contract
claims.note: beIN gives EUR 50m, EUR 16m add-ons, five years.

claims.claim: The club's own statement does not give a fee
Plays mainly on the left, can play right, has played wing-back, full-back and attacking midfielder
claims.note: Focus piece lists left winger, wing-back, full-back, occasionally attacking midfield.

claims.claim: Milan beat Inter 3-1 at San Siro on 31 October 2026, the day after the Goal interview was published
claims.note: Both report Saturday 31 Oct 2026, Milan 3-1 Inter. Goal interview dated 30 Oct 2026.

claims.claim: Pulisic headed in Moreira's cross in the fourth minute
claims.note: Pulisic 4' assisted by Moreira; cross for a header.

claims.claim: Moreira set up Adrien Rabiot's goal in the tenth minute
Bastoni pulled one back; Moreira curled a left-footed free kick from about 25 yards over the wall in the 43rd minute to restore the two-goal lead
claims.note: Bastoni 22', Moreira 43' left-footed from 25 yards; 'over the wall' from Football Italia.

claims.claim: Opta: third direct free kick by a Milan player in the derby since 2004-05 data
claims.note: Article names Pirlo 2007 and Theo Hernandez 2025 as the earlier two.

claims.claim: Interview published by Goal on 30 October 2026; name chosen partly because of Diego Maradona
claims.note: Publication date 30 Oct 2026; 'also because of Diego Maradona'. The DAZN detail was removed because the source only says he spoke to DAZN.

claims.claim: Cristiano Ronaldo is his idol
Derby is one of the most important matches in Europe
Wears 22 because he likes it; honour to follow Kaka
Breakdance answer, 'I don't want to get injured'
Left home at 15 to pursue football
claims.note: 'When I was 15, I left home and my mum for football.'

claims.claim: Born in Liege on 6 August 2004
claims.note: Both give the date; Wikidata used as a lead only and cited alongside the club statement.

claims.claim: Full name Diego Manuel Jadon da Silva Moreira
Father Almami, Guinea-Bissau international and Standard midfielder; grandfather Helmut Graf at Standard 1976-1982
Academies of Standard Liege and Benfica; Youth League 2021/22 with Benfica U19; U20 Intercontinental Cup a few months later
Joined Benfica summer 2020 and signed first professional contract
Champions League debut in a qualifier against Midtjylland in August 2022
Chelsea signed him in summer 2023; debut in August in Carabao Cup against AFC Wimbledon
Loan to Lyon in 2023/24, nine appearances, returned January 2024
claims.note: Nine appearances and January 2024 return stated; loan season is implied, not labelled.

claims.claim: Moved to RC Strasbourg permanently in summer 2024
claims.note: 'completing a permanent move to RC Strasbourg in the summer of 2024'.

claims.claim: 76 appearances and seven goals at Strasbourg over two seasons
Assist totals: beIN 15, AC Milan feature 16
Led Strasbourg in chances created (66)
Helped Strasbourg come close to the Conference League final; dedicated, strong work ethic
Two Under-15 matches for Belgium before choosing Portugal
Came through Portugal's youth teams and played at the 2023 U21 Euro
In May 2025 the governing body approved the change of association from Portugal to Belgium
claims.note: DH article of 20 May 2025 reports the change as validated; Wikidata dates it to 19 May 2025 (FIFA platform).

claims.claim: By September 2025 first competitive senior appearances in World Cup qualifiers and friendlies
claims.note: 'by September' stated; year implied by the 2025 switch.

claims.claim: Only World Cup appearance: substitute in round-of-32 win over Senegal
Shared a dressing room with Saelemaekers and De Winter at the tournament
Nationality Belgian
FAQ: 22 as of 2 Nov 2026, from DOB 6 Aug 2004
FAQ: did not play for Portugal; FIFA approved change to Belgium in May 2025
claims.note: Youth teams and the change are supported. No senior Portugal cap is claimed.

valueNote: Adds the October 2026 derby, sourced to two match reports including Opta data, which the older pages lack.
summary: All body and FAQ claims checked against sources; the DAZN detail was removed and the free kick now cites both match reports.
